cluster_commentary.draft: The perturbation sector contains the distinctive EFC signatures — non-monotonic lensing (P1), gravitational-slip enhancement (P3), and the Horndeski no-go (P5). All three are structural discriminators: they cannot be mimicked by ΛCDM + nuisance parameters. Stage-IV tomography (Euclid DR1, SO × Euclid) is required to test them.
P2 (fσ8 at z=0.7) and P4 (Rubin DP2 S8) are DAMAGE-class: failure erodes motivation without falsifying the framework. Both are quantitative point predictions with explicit ΛCDM comparison.
P5 (Horndeski no-go) and P6 (background sign lemma) are closed — either analytically proven or exhaustively scanned. They are listed for completeness, not as open tests.
